**WHY WORK AT JOE & THE JUICE

**JOE & THE JUICE is a people-centric food and beverage company built around culture, offering much more than just juice, sandwiches, and coffee.

We believe in four simple virtues that shape everything we do:

• Positive Attitude

• Inclusion

• Social Ties

• Growth

For us, this means that when you choose a cup-half-full mindset, welcome people from every background, build real friendships across the bar by creating great guest experiences, and use every shift as a chance to learn something new, you become more than just a Juicer; like us, you continue to search and find purpose and meaning in what you do.

From your first day, you'll be part of an international network of Juicers who support each other, celebrate wins together, and push each other to grow. You will learn by doing and move through our Moneyball career path, our internal system that tracks your performance and fast-tracks you toward promotion. Most of our leaders have earned their stripes behind the bar (fun fact: over 75% of our employees started as Juicers!), so you will always be part of a company built on that same journey. If you love a fast-paced environment, music, and people, and you like the idea of turning a job into a lifestyle, JOE can become a place to build skills, friendships, and a career that takes you across cities, countries, and roles.

**JOB SUMMARY

**We are looking for an FP&A Specialist to strengthen our Corporate FP&A team and take ownership of cash flow forecasting, balance sheet planning, working capital management, and other key planning activities below Adjusted EBITDA across the Group.

Reporting directly to the Head of FP&A, you will play a key role in advancing our financial planning capabilities and driving transparency across cash flow, liquidity, and balance sheet performance. You will work closely with Accounting, Tax, Controlling, regional Finance teams, and key business stakeholders to ensure robust planning processes and high-quality management reporting.

This is a unique opportunity to:

• Take ownership of the Group's cash flow, balance sheet, and working capital planning agenda, helping to improve cash generation and support management decision-making.

• Shape and develop our Workday Adaptive Planning capabilities, leading key initiatives to establish scalable planning models and reporting structures.

• Work across markets and functions, partnering with regional Finance teams and senior stakeholders to strengthen forecasting, reporting, and business insight throughout the organization.

The successful candidate will help establish best-in-class planning processes that connect P&L, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow forecasting, providing management with greater visibility into liquidity, working capital performance, and long-term value creation. The role is a full-time role and reports to the Head of Group Financial Planning & Analysis.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

**

• Own the Group's cash flow planning across forecast, budget, and long-range planning cycles.

• Drive the development of balance sheet forecasting capabilities and ensure alignment between P&L, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow planning.

• Lead the implementation and continuous development of cash flow and balance sheet planning models in Workday Adaptive Planning.

• Define business requirements and partner closely with the BI Team to improve planning processes, reporting capabilities, and system functionality.

• Partner with Accounting, Controlling, Tax, and regional Finance teams to strengthen cash flow and balance sheet reporting, improve forecast accuracy, and establish clear ownership across planning activities.

• Develop and maintain monthly cash flow, balance sheet, and working capital reporting, including variance analysis, key risks and opportunities, and actionable management insights.

• Establish and maintain a clear RACI framework across Finance for balance sheet and cash flow planning, forecasting, and follow-up activities.

• Develop driver-based forecasting methodologies for key working capital metrics, including inventory, receivables, payables, and other material balance sheet accounts.

• Monitor working capital performance and identify opportunities to improve cash conversion and optimize working capital.

• Partner with Operations, Supply Chain, Accounting, and Controlling to strengthen understanding of working capital drivers and improve forecast accuracy.

• Support Executive Management and Board reporting by providing insights on cash generation, liquidity, working capital performance, and financial risks and opportunities.

• Drive continuous improvement of forecasting methodologies, planning processes, and financial transparency across the organization.

• Support the ongoing development of FP&A capabilities by integrating balance sheet and cash flow considerations into strategic and long-range planning processes.

**WHO YOU ARE

**You are a curious and analytical finance professional with a passion for turning data into insights and helping the business make better decisions. You enjoy working across functions, building strong stakeholder relationships, and taking ownership of complex planning processes.

You thrive in a dynamic and growing environment and are comfortable navigating between operational details and the bigger picture. You enjoy driving improvements, challenging assumptions, and creating structure where it is needed.

You are comfortable working across Finance functions and partnering with regional Finance teams to improve forecasting, strengthen financial transparency, and drive continuous improvement. Most importantly, you are proactive, structured, and motivated by creating impact through high-quality financial planning and analysis.

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING

**

• 5+ years of experience within FP&A, Financial Controlling, Corporate Finance, or a similar role.

• Strong understanding of financial statements, budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning.

• Experience working with cash flow forecasting, working capital, balance sheet analysis, or investment planning.

• Solid financial modelling and analytical skills, including advanced Excel capabilities.

• Experience with Workday Adaptive Planning or other EPM/planning tools is an advantage.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

• A proactive mindset and a passion for improving processes, systems, and ways of working.

• Experience from retail, hospitality, food & beverage, consumer goods, or other multi-site businesses is considered a plus.

**OUR BENEFITS

**We offer a benefits package that includes a paid pension plan, health insurance, parental leave, and additional vacation. Besides that, we provide some JOE-ified benefits:

• Our global headquarters is conveniently located in the heart of beautiful Copenhagen, where over 200 friendly faces come together!

• Fantastic office facilities, including a fully staffed JOE & THE JUICE bar, where we serve delicious breakfast, daily lunch, refreshing juices, and top-notch barista coffee.

• At JOE, we embrace a flat hierarchy that values every opinion, creating a welcoming space for your ideas and suggestions to thrive.

• Lively monthly social calendar filled with fun activities like running club, wine tasting, creative evenings, and Friday bars - there's always something exciting happening!

• As part of our team, you'll have the opportunity to take on a BTC (Behind the Counter) shift in one of our bars twice a year, adding a unique touch to your experience.

**Ready to turn a job into a lifestyle?

****ABOUT JOE & THE JUICE

**Founded in Copenhagen in 2002, JOE & THE JUICE has grown into a global fast-casual concept with more than 500 locations across 25+ countries and over 7,000 employees worldwide, with our sights set on 1,000 stores by 2028.

Our people-centric culture and sustainability agenda are part of our Nordic heritage, and remain central to our commitment to a better future. Along the way, internal workshops and mentorship sharpen your skills, while exchange programs and international assignments can take you across our markets.

Ready to embark on this exciting journey? Apply today and become a part of JOE & THE JUICE!

Do you have a passion for pharmaceutical quality, but also believe that Quality should be about more than compliance?

At Fertin Pharma, we develop and manufacture pharmaceutical and nutraceutical products in partnership with leading global and regional brands, combining pharmaceutical expertise with innovative oral delivery technologies.

We are looking for a QA Specialist who wants to work close to our pharmaceutical operations and help us ensure the quality of our products and continuously strengthen the way we manufacture. You will become part of an environment where GMP, manufacturing, and continuous improvement come together.

About the role:

As QA Specialist, you will collaborate closely with colleagues across Quality and Operations. Your role will combine day-to-day quality activities with investigation, problem solving, and continuous improvement. You will have the opportunity to influence how we work with quality and help move from simply reacting to quality issues towards preventing them through stronger processes and effective collaboration. Your responsibilities may include:

• Supporting and approving deviation investigations, including root-cause analysis and CAPAs

• Participating in the release process of our pharmaceutical products

• Providing GMP and quality support to pharmaceutical manufacturing

• Reviewing and approving manufacturing documentation

• Participating in change controls, risk assessments, and quality improvement activities

• Contributing to the simplification of our Quality Management System

• Supporting inspection and audit readiness

• Participating in cross-functional projects where quality expertise is needed

Who are you?

Your exact educational background is less important than your ability to understand processes, challenge constructively and turn complex quality issues into practical solutions. We imagine that you:

• Have a relevant scientific, engineering, or pharmaceutical background

• Preferably have experience from pharmaceutical or other highly regulated industry

• It would be considered a strong advantage if your educational background and professional experience meet the requirements for acting as a delegated Qualified Person (QP Delegate) according to Danish requirements

• Understand GMP and preferably have practical experience working within a pharmaceutical Quality Management System

• Can balance compliance, risk and operational reality

• Have experience with, or an interest in, deviations, CAPA, root-cause analysis and risk management

• Is curious and comfortable asking why

• Communicate clearly and collaborate naturally across functions

If you are motivated by making quality work in practice, not simply administering it, we would like to hear from you. Send your cover letter and CV as soon as possible via the link below. Interviews will be conducted on an ongoing basis.

Special Conditions:

As part of our recruitment process, we conduct background checks on all candidates who accept an offer of employment with Fertin. A satisfactory background check is a condition of employment. The background check is a standard and important part of our hiring process and is carried out in accordance with applicable laws and regulations, as well as Fertin’s internal compliance and integrity requirements.

As ESG Reporting Advisor, you will help prepare Novo’s ESG reporting, including the Sustainability statement in the Annual Report, and make sure the data behind it is accurate, transparent and trusted. Investors, regulators, employees and other external stakeholders rely on this reporting to understand Novo’s sustainability commitments and progress. You will be responsible for selected metrics, EU Taxonomy reporting and to improve our data collection and controlling processes.

What you’ll bring

The ESG space is changing fast. You will do well here if you:

• Thrive in a high-pace environment where things are anything but at steady state.

• Enjoy working in a large organisation with many stakeholders and handling many different tasks at once.

• Bring a pragmatic, can-do attitude.

• Communicate clearly and interact confidently with stakeholders at all levels.

Useful, but not essential: one or several of the following

• A bachelor’s or master’s degree related to ESG topics, business or auditing.

• Minimum 3+ years’ experience in sustainability, ESG reporting or as an ESG consultant.

• Knowledge of ESG reporting methodologies and frameworks, such as CSRD, EU Taxonomy and the GHG Protocol.

• Experience with ESG assurance and internal controls.

What you’ll do

You will help deliver high-quality ESG reporting and strengthen how it is produced. Your work will include:

• Preparing Novo’s ESG reporting, including the Sustainability statement in the Annual Report.

• Taking responsibility for selected metrics (climate, pollution, nature, circularity, own workforce, business conduct or equitable access) and making sure they are reported accurately and transparently.

• Working closely with stakeholders across the business on data collection and carrying out controls and checks on key ESG metrics.

• Owning our EU Taxonomy reporting.

• Improving data collection and consolidation processes and strengthening the internal ESG control environment.

• Driving continuous improvement of existing processes with AI and other digital tools.

Who you’ll work with

You will be part of ESG Reporting at our headquarters in Bagsværd, outside Copenhagen. The ESG Reporting team has 8 colleagues across Denmark and India. ESG Reporting sits within Finance under the CFO, as part of Corporate Accounting, led by Rikke Ryttergaard Andersen. Corporate Accounting has approximately 40 colleagues with a great mix of age, gender and nationality.

What you can expect here

You will work on a topic that is moving quickly, with room to contribute your expertise and shape how ESG reporting is done. You will build new skills by working across the business and by using AI and digital tools in your daily work. You will be supported to perform at your best, trusted to take ownership and encouraged to speak up when things are stalling.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 570,200DKK -838,100DKK corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

Start now

For further information, please contact Helle Bjerring Becker at HBJB@novonordisk.com.

_Pandora jewellery is loved by millions. Do you want to help keep the company as strong as the love its products attract? ... If so, this could be the opportunity you’ve been looking for!

_****_Pandora sells more jewellery than any brand in the world, at a gross margin of around 80 percent, among the strongest in consumer goods. That strength is what lets the brand keep creating, designing, crafting and showing up for the people who wear it, and what earns the trust of the investors who back it. Guarding it, piece by piece and collection by collection, is what this newly created role is for. We deliver on our promises, and precious metals at multi-year highs are testing every jewellery maker's discipline right now. The brands that keep their craft and their strength through it will set the pace. That is the work, and it starts immediately.

_**Pandora's success is built on product: design that powers both the love for the brand and the profit that sustains it, and an assortment where every piece earns its place, in the stores and in people's hearts. You will build product profitability governance with our Product organization: what enters the assortment and on what threshold, what leaves it and when, and how design, cost, price and mix add up to a portfolio that earns steady love from millions.

You lead through mandate and the forums you chair, not headcount: the team is deliberately senior and flat, and your counterparts are the CPO leadership team, Merchandising, Revenue Growth Management, Craft & Supply finance and the CFO office. Your work is in front of the Executive Leadership Team every cycle, at the center of the company's strategic agenda.

**What You Will Do

**

• Design and chair the product gate and lifecycle forums, moving with the assortment cycle: thresholds set, decisions evidenced, follow-through visible, and a line where every piece earns its place.

• Own the numbers behind what every product costs and earns, hands-on in the cost and BI systems, and build the story behind them, told at Executive Leadership and investor standard.

• Partner Product Strategy, Merchandising, pricing and Craft & Supply finance on how design choices become cost, how whole product families keep earning as they grow, and the link between what we choose to sell and what we charge.

• Hold the finance position with senior product stakeholders on thresholds and lifecycle decisions, and keep the partnership strong while you do it.

• Direct a product finance analyst on content and draw on a shared analytics bench built for exactly this work. Contribute to building agentic capabilities to expand the value you deliver.

**What Is Needed To Succeed

**

• 10+ years in product or gross margin finance from vertically integrated retail or consumer goods; you have run a costing or product-profitability function, not only analyzed one.

• Hands-on analytical depth that has stayed recent: you build and defend margin baselines yourself, and master data is familiar ground.

• A track record of building governance that held: gates or lifecycle forums with thresholds that survived contested, sponsored proposals.

• Credibility in front of a CFO and a CPO in the same meeting.

**Who You Are

**

• A self-starter: you break the ice on work nobody has owned before and bring structure where there was none.

• You develop and defend your own point of view, and you change it when the evidence says so.

• Consumer-centric: you know growth comes from products people love and a brand they think of first, and you read margin through that lens. Multipliers, not mechanical levers.

• You believe finance is a strategic copilot to the business, in the room when plans are made, not after they are priced. And you see it as the essential guardrail that keeps a company strong enough to be trusted, by the people who wear the jewellery and the investors who back it.

• You can have difficult conversations respectfully: holding strategic financial realities against a proposal someone loves, and keeping the relationship.

• People-centric and a collaborator: you build capability in others and win as a team across functions.

Reporting into the Sr Director, Global Product & Marketing Finance, you will join a small, senior team at the center of a chapter Pandora is building on design, brand and the discipline underneath them, with a mandate sponsored from the top of the company, the room to build, and a market that will not wait.

**Additional Information

**Global Career Band 4A - Senior Manager.

Hybrid Working Flexibility – 3 days in office per week

Location Copenhagen; Global scope.

English is our working language; Danish is not required.

Did we get your attention?    We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to send your application as soon as possible. You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site www.pandoragroup.com.

Icing on the cake

You will be working out of our beautiful Head Office in Copenhagen V, established in 2016 and designed to unite and inspire our teams. Besides our beautiful interior design, we are also proud of our LEED Gold Certification for Energy and Environmental Design. This means that we use as few natural resources as possible and that we use them with respect. The result is a professional and dynamic space that is unique, comfortable and inspirational – and delivers a true Pandora experience to anyone who works here or comes to visit.

**About Pandora

**Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

At Pandora, we believe that creating an inclusive and diverse workplace and reflecting societal diversity in our customer engagement is essential to delivering on our company purpose: to give a voice to people’s loves. We dedicate ourselves to fostering, cultivating and preserving a culture of inclusion and diversity where everyone feels respected and valued.

Do you want to be a part of the world’s leading jewellery company while putting your experience within Strategic Portfolio Management in Digital & Technology into use? If yes, then we might have an exciting opportunity for you!

You will be part of an exciting and growing business area and work in an international organisation of can-do spirited, passionate, and performance-driven people. We value flexibility, an energised atmosphere and treasure our informal, independent working style. You are trusted to deliver in a setting where answers are not already given but can be found in collaboration with others.

Join the Team Behind the Portfolio

In 2027, we continue to strengthen the larger Delivery & Planning team, a passionate team of thinkers, makers and doers focused on strategy development, portfolio management and delivery excellence across Pandora’s Digital & Technology, linking Pandora’s strategy to execution.

Our portfolio spans initiatives, projects and programmes delivered through agile and traditional methodologies. We work directly with business colleagues, senior stakeholders and digital teams to develop and maintain our portfolio strategy and governance framework, ensuring alignment with Pandora’s strategic priorities.

We are on a mission to provide leadership with clear insights on investments, capacity, risks and dependencies, and facilitate complex cross-domain decisions to mitigate risks and optimise for the best business outcomes.

As our new Interim Senior Manager, Portfolio Management, you will lead the Portfolio Management function and enable decision-making processes that help Pandora’s Digital & Technology portfolio deliver measurable business value.

This is a maternity cover role, expected to run for approximately nine months.

Help Write Our Next Chapter:

• Lead and develop a team of four, fostering a high-performance culture and continuous capability growth.

• Facilitate cross-domain discussions and shape options by providing insights, scenarios and recommendations that support informed decisions.

• Enable portfolio-level capacity planning and workforce alignment in partnership with Finance and HR.

• Develop and maintain the portfolio strategy and value-realisation framework, ensuring investments connect to strategic priorities and OKRs.

• Establish mechanisms for prioritising and planning technology initiatives and facilitate cross-portfolio alignment.

• Conduct portfolio analysis, including early risk identification, dependency management, conflict resolution and financial analysis.

• Maintain a strategic roadmap across the technology portfolio and provide continuous insights into portfolio health, progress and value realisation.

• Continuously optimise portfolio management processes, data and tools in collaboration with the Delivery Enablement team.

We would love if you could bring:

• At least seven years’ experience in Portfolio Management, Product Management or Project Management, supporting large and complex portfolios.

• A strong track record of leading and enabling teams, fostering high performance and capability growth.

• Proven experience engaging and influencing senior stakeholders, including presenting portfolio insights, scenarios and recommendations to leadership.

• A deep understanding of business models, strategic priorities and value drivers.

• The ability to collaborate effectively across Enterprise Architecture, PMO, Product Management and Engineering leadership.

• Experience delivering through both agile and waterfall methodologies.

• In-depth knowledge of technology development lifecycles and portfolio governance best practices.

• Experience in outcome-based planning and measurement, including OKRs.

• Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint and Excel, as well as tools such as Confluence and Jira.

We know that great talent comes from different backgrounds and experiences. If this role excites you and you can see yourself bringing many of these skills to the team, we would love to hear your story.

Ready to Craft Your Next Career Chapter?

If you can see yourself bringing your expertise, making an impact and contributing to Pandora during this important period, we would love to hear from you. Please submit your application in English. Applications are reviewed on a continuous basis, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

The Additional Sparkle

You’ll be based at our Digital & Technology building at Havneholmen in Copenhagen, working alongside talented colleagues in an international and collaborative environment.

Our LEED Gold-certified building is designed to bring people together and provides a modern workplace where you can connect, collaborate and share ideas.

We produce and sell our products business-to-business exclusively. Our Customer references span from small, local manufacturers to large, global companies within our different markets. We focus greatly on safety, as well as showing he right safety-measures. Being a part of maintaining the safety culture is a very important part of our daily work and routine.

We develop and provide value-adding vegetable oil solutions in close collaboration with our customers, enabling them to achieve long lasting business results.

The position:

HR Specialist.

Do you have a broad HR admin profile?

Are you firmly grounded in system- and process competencies?

We are looking for a professional, strong and experienced HR Specialist with experience from international production environments. You focus on structure, processes and IT tools, which can contribute to the development and execution of our admin, development & recruitment efforts. You will become part of an exciting development process in a global corporation, which is one of the industry’s most significant players.

The position:

With reference to the Head of HR, you are given the responsibility to build and further develop our plans and efforts within HRM systems as well as data management and extraction.

You will be responsible for introducing and implementing Cornerstone (AAK People), Mercer, Tableau and other relevant HR IT tools as well as working extensively with job profiles, job descriptions, revising employment contracts, employee handbook and policies etc.

You have solid experience with processes and best practice in recruitment and onboarding, which takes place across our sites inland and abroad. You have extensive experience with recruitment processes and manage them independently.

It is crucial you possess a strong business understanding and your passion for HR is driven by the needs and values of the business.

It is a small and operational HR team, which must be able to execute at all levels within the entire group.

Responsibilities:

• Participate in the development and planning of HR tasks in general and in the areas of responsibility as well as reporting

• Introducing, incorporating and supporting the users with Cornerstone, Mercer, Tableau and other HRM IT tools into the organization

• Subject Matter Expert regionally on eg recruitment or other areas of the HR lifecycle

• Contribute with job descriptions/profiles, contracts and policies as well as updating the employee handbook

• Recruitment excellence: Recruitment and introduction/onboarding

• Organizing and evt. conducting internal trainings

• Assist in designing and updating GDPR processes

• Back-up of monthly reports to managers, social security etc.

The candidate:

Systematic, structured and business-oriented – focus on execution and outcome

There are many ways into this role. Your background may be a relevant mercantile education such as cand.merc., HD-O or equivalent, but most important is your “toolbox”, experiences from a similar role in an international production company and not least your personality.

You can balance the “thinker and doer” – in other words, you like to create structures and processes, most often based on IT tools and to execute and create results in the business. You manage to convert the strategic vision for HR into concrete efforts with structure and action which create results and work in practice.

Furthermore, you are a role model for the values, the good colleague and collaboration across the organization. You are a team player and ensure everyone, as a team, reach our goals.

You are based on the site in Aarhus with a few travel days per year. You speak and write Danish and English on a professional level. In addition, you are a seasoned SAP and Microsoft Office user. You are offered a challenging position in a globally oriented corporation with high ambitions. You will become part of a dedicated team with an open and positive attitude.

It’s an exciting time to join Tactile. We're a diverse team of storytellers, puzzle enthusiasts, and casual mobile game creators. Our story began in 2008 in the heart of beautiful Copenhagen, and since then, we have experienced continuous growth, establishing ourselves as one of the largest gaming companies in Denmark. In more recent years, we have been scaling fast, in large part thanks to the success of a little game called Lily’s Garden. Now we’re on a mission to solidify our position as one of the leaders in creating out-of-the-ordinary casual puzzle games.

With more than 350 talented individuals, we are a mix of over 50 nationalities and 43% women. We truly appreciate the richness of different experiences and perspectives that Tactilers bring to the game. This is why we foster a lean organisational culture, in which each individual is encouraged to take responsibility, be open, and grow in their own way. We pride ourselves on cultivating a studio environment that avoids crunch, fosters your skills regardless of your discipline, and provides a space for you to be creative alongside other passionate and invested storytellers.

🚀 Your role & impact:

We're currently growing our Core team and are on the lookout for another Product Designer to join our team of talented engineers.

The Core team builds the internal tools behind Tactile own LiveOps, Marketing and Data operations, the backbone of our studio. We're looking for a second Product Designer to join Joy and our engineers in designing business-critical tools that every team at Tactile depends on.

This role is based in our Copenhagen office.

How we design:

• Our tools are data-heavy: dashboards, large tables, complex filters, multi-step workflows. Static mockups can't show how they behave with real data, so we prototype first, in code. _Do you have hands-on experience with SimCorp Dimension and an interest in financial processes across mortgage banking, asset management, risk, regulatory reporting and liquidity management? Join Treasury Products and help develop modern, robust IT solutions.

_You will work with core financial processes and contribute to a strategic programme modernising Treasury’s IT landscape, including SimCorp Dimension, integrations and data.

**Your role

**Nykredit Wealth Technology delivers IT solutions for key financial business areas. Treasury Products supports mortgage banking, proprietary portfolio management, risk, liquidity management and regulatory reporting.

SimCorp Dimension is central to this business-critical value chain. You will work at the intersection of financial products, business processes, data and technology.

You will join a skilled team and collaborate with business units, vendors and colleagues across Wealth Technology.

**Help shape the future Treasury platform

**The Treasury Greenfield Programme is modernising Treasury’s IT landscape and strengthening the robustness of the value chain across SimCorp Dimension, surrounding systems, integrations and data sources.

Our ambition is to replace the older on-premises platform with a modern, cloud-based SimCorp Dimension SaaS solution and shape the future SCD setup and Treasury it architecture.

As our new Specialist, you will contribute to this transformation, apply your experience and develop your specialist capabilities.

**Your Primary Responsibilities

**

• Analyse business needs and translate them into robust, flexible IT solutions

• Develop, configure and implement solutions in SimCorp Dimension

• Collaborate with Treasury, Risk and other business areas

• Contribute to the Treasury Greenfield Programme and future platform

• Solve challenges across processes, data and technology

• Maintain solutions and share knowledge across the team.

**Your profile

**You may come from an IT role involving SimCorp Dimension and financial solutions or from the business side Front Office, Middle Office or Back Office working with Simcorp Dimension. Hands-on experience with SimCorp Dimension is required. You do not need to be an expert, but you must have a solid basic understanding of the platform.

In addition, we imagine that you:

• have a relevant background in IT, economics or finance,

• are interested in Treasury, capital markets and technology,

• are curious and motivated to develop your specialist capabilities,

• work in a structured way, take ownership and follow through,

• collaborate well and communicate complex topics clearly.

**Your team

**You will join a team that values expertise, collaboration and knowledge sharing.

We combine different skills and perspectives in a trusting, informal environment where colleagues help and challenge each other.

We expect curiosity, responsibility and an ambition to develop with the team—not that you know everything from day one.

**What We Offer

**We offer a specialist role combining capital markets, mortgage banking, business and technology in an area of significant importance to Nykredit. You can develop your Treasury and SimCorp Dimension expertise while contributing to a strategic transformation. You will work with committed colleagues and take on greater responsibility as your expertise grows.

We also offer competitive employment terms, attractive employee benefits and flexible working conditions.

**Want to know more?

**If you have any questions about the position, please feel free to contact me, Thomas Skou, Head of Department, at +45 44 55 99 48.

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact our Recruitment Team at nytjob@nykredit.dk.

We review applications and invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis and will close the recruitment process once we have found the right candidate.

We look forward to receiving your application and CV.

At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

**The Role

**Genmab’s CMC Writing team is looking for a Regulatory CMC Writer to support global marketing applications across our growing portfolio.

In this role, you will author and participate in the review of high-quality CMC documentation, with a primary focus on global Biologics License Applications (BLAs), Marketing Authorisation Applications (MAAs), and New Drug Applications (NDAs). Working closely with scientific and technical experts, you will translate complex manufacturing, analytical, and formulation development information into clear, accurate, and consistent regulatory submission documents.

You will join a dedicated team of CMC writers and collaborate with colleagues and external partners across late-stage development, regulatory submission, and lifecycle management activities. Your contribution will help ensure that CMC documentation presents a coherent scientific rationale and is delivered within agreed submission timelines. You will also contribute to improving writing quality and efficiency through the thoughtful use of AI and digital tools.

The position reports to the Director, Head of CMC Writing, and is based in Copenhagen, Denmark.

**Key Responsibilities

**Your primary focus will be CMC documentation supporting global BLA/MAA/NDA filings and responses to health authority questions during assessment.

**Your Responsibilities Include

**

• Authoring and reviewing Module 3 CTD sections, covering manufacturing processes, process controls, analytical procedures, characterization, specifications, formulation development, stability, and facility

• Translating technical reports and source data into clear, scientifically sound regulatory narratives in close collaboration with subject matter experts

• Coordinating document preparation and review with CMC Project Managers, subject matter experts, Regulatory Affairs CMC, Quality Assurance, and external partners, including contract manufacturing organizations

• Consolidating review comments, facilitating their resolution, and ensuring that documents are completed and approved within agreed timelines

• Verifying the accuracy of data presented in CMC documents against source documentation and ensuring consistency across related sections and submissions

• Authoring and coordinating responses to health authority questions and implementing the resulting updates to CMC submission documents

• Maintaining source document trackers and ensuring traceability of supporting information and regulatory document updates

• Supporting lifecycle maintenance of CMC documentation, including post-approval changes, and contributing to IND/CTA submissions and amendments as needed

• Applying AI and digital tools to improve writing quality, consistency, and efficiency, while critically evaluating outputs and ensuring scientific accuracy and appropriate handling of confidential information

• Following and contributing to the continuous improvement of CMC writing and response principles, templates, internal procedures, and style guides

• Performing CMC writing activities in accordance with Genmab’s quality system and applicable procedures

**Requirements

**You hold a master’s degree in science or related technical discipline. An advanced degree or relevant professional certification is preferred.

You bring at least four years of experience in CMC or a related field within the pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry, with relevant experience in biologics and/or chemical development and manufacturing. We welcome candidates with backgrounds in biologics, small molecules, or both.

**In Addition, You Have

**

• Experience authoring and reviewing CMC regulatory sections or supporting source documents, with the ability to take ownership of defined sections with limited supervision

• Experience participating in global regulatory submissions and/or a strong background in pharmaceutical or biotechnology product development and manufacturing processes. Direct experience supporting BLA, MAA, or NDA filings is a strong advantage

• A good understanding of CMC regulatory requirements across development stages and familiarity with CTD structure

• Knowledge of GxP, regulatory compliance, and documentation requirements relevant to CMC activities

• Excellent written English and the ability to distil complex scientific information into clear, concise, and well-structured text

• Strong attention to detail, with the ability to verify data, identify inconsistencies, and maintain scientific accuracy across documents

• Practical experience using AI tools to improve scientific or technical writing quality and efficiency, including the ability to formulate effective prompts, critically assess outputs, and verify scientific content

• Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to coordinate cross-functional reviews and facilitate alignment without direct authority

• A proactive and structured approach to planning, prioritizing, and delivering quality work within demanding submission timelines

• A demonstrated track record of effective collaboration and reliable delivery in previous roles, together with curiosity, openness to feedback, and an interest in improving ways of working

Application deadline: 1. November 2026

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK582.400,00---873.600,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

**Benefits

**When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Are you passionate about product data and the systems that turn it into consistent, high-quality experiences everywhere it's used? Do you enjoy the technical challenge of connecting complex data flows across platforms? Do you thrive on making product information easy to find, understand, and trust—for customers and for AI? If so, we might have the perfect opportunity for you!

Pandora's team is looking for a Product Manager to own our Product Information Management (PIM) practice. Help Write Our Next Chapter - Job Responsibilities:

• Experience writing clear product requirements and managing backlogs in tools like JIRA

• Analytical mindset with a focus on measuring data quality and discoverability impact

• Excellent stakeholder management skills—you can navigate between technical and business teams with ease

We know that great talent comes from different backgrounds and experiences. If this role excites you and you can see yourself bringing many of these skills to the team, we’d love to hear your story!

Meet the People Behind the Sparkle

You’ll join our Product Management team, alongside colleagues in Copenhagen and Baltimore, working in a collaborative and international environment. Reporting directly to the Director, Product Management, you’ll work closely with teams across e-commerce, stores, retail technology, brand, marketplaces and local markets, giving you broad exposure across Pandora and plenty of opportunity to collaborate across the business.

Further Information:

Global Career Band: This role is a Manager, Band 4B, individual contributor position.

Be Part of Something Beautiful

At Pandora, we’re crafting more than jewellery. We’re creating the future of an iconic global brand. You’ll work from our Digital & Technology Hub in Copenhagen alongside talented colleagues from around the world, helping shape the digital experiences, platforms, and technologies that support millions of customers and employees every day. From our LEED Gold-certified workplace to our commitment to sustainability, innovation, and craftsmanship, Pandora offers an environment where you can do meaningful work, grow your career, and make a lasting impact.

The result is a workplace that is innovative, collaborative and inspirational, delivering a true Pandora experience to everyone who works here or comes to visit.
